annotation.authors_or_issuer: Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA)
key_provisions_or_claims: Updated NSDAI aims for Saudi Arabia to rank among the world's top 10 smart nations.
Five pillars with 17 strategic objectives, including sovereign infrastructure, data management, digital platforms, AI applications and sector enablement.
Objective 5.1 strengthens AI ethics and safety governance.
Targets through 2034 include up to 55,000 Data & AI talents and 100% coverage of government services via the super app.
SDAIA leads implementation with KPIs and performance tracking.
annotation.summary_en: Overview of Saudi Arabia's updated National Strategy for Data and AI (NSDAI, 2026 update), led by SDAIA. It sets a top-10 smart nation ambition, five pillars and 17 objectives covering infrastructure, data management, digital services, AI applications and sector enablement, with KPIs and targets through 2034.
